thread:
Maria G: Quick check before cutoff in ~3h — I want to lock down the annotated tag text, confirm artifact owners, and get the tag signed. Can owners ack and paste the annotated tag body we should use?

Jordan P: I'll own uploading linux/wheel artifacts. Will push to s3 and attach checksums here in ~15m :+1:

Kevin L: I can sign the git tag. Proposed annotated tag message (feel free to tweak):
```
v1.4.0

Redwood Inference v1.4.0
- runtime: KV cache leak fix
- runtime: improved batching heuristics for long sequences
- api: preserve stream ordering for function calls
- infra: publish wheel + linux tar artifacts

See CHANGELOG.md for details.
```
Push command I plan to run:
```
git tag -a v1.4.0 -m "v1.4.0: runtime + API fixes" && git push origin v1.4.0
```

Rachel S: Changelog updated in `CHANGELOG.md` on `release/x` branch. I added a one-liner migration note under "API changes".

Jordan P: Uploaded artifacts -> s3://redwood-releases/v1.4.0/
release-bot: checksum report -> ok (sha256): linux.tar.gz: abc123..., wheels.zip: def456... (signed: no)

Kevin L: Signing now. I'll create the signed annotated tag and push. Will paste the annotated message I used here after push.

devops-bot: Reminder — branch freeze in 3h 05m. Any PRs targeting `release/x` must be merged before cutoff or they'll go to next patch.

Maria G: Thanks — when tag is pushed, can someone also create a draft GH release and paste the URL? I'll fill release notes and set the release to "annotated". :shipit:

Jordan P: Will create draft release once tag shows up. I'll include links to the artifacts and checksums.

release-bot: tag v1.4.0 pushed by Kevin L at 1765433400; signature present: true

Kevin L: Done. Annotated tag message I used (copied from local):
```
v1.4.0

Runtime: fixed kv cache leak and improved batching heuristics for long sequences.
API: ensure stream order for function call responses.
Infra: add linux tar and wheels for this release.

Signed-off-by: Kevin L <kevin@redwood.ai>
```

Rachel S: Verified CHANGELOG links and dependency table. No outstanding blockers from docs side.

Maria G: Perfect. Jordan — draft release URL when ready?

Jordan P: Draft created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v1.4.0 (draft)

Maria G: Awesome. I'll finish notes and mark ready-to-publish 20m before cutoff.

Kevin L: If anyone needs me to re-sign or reword tag, ping me. Otherwise I'll be on call for the publish window.

Maria G: Great work, team. :tada:
